root_cause: powerhouse_predictive_commercial_brief_cache_v1 is a materialized view that no scheduled job refreshed; it was last refreshed 2026-10-05, so triggers, heat and commercial_state were 22 days old.
fix: Daily pg_cron job at 05:50 UTC refreshes the cache before outreach preparation (06:21 UTC), with an advisory lock and a 110s timeout.
prevention_rule: Every materialized view that feeds commercial decisions needs a scheduled refresh and a freshness check.
terminal_rule: Next day, max(refreshed_at) of the cache is newer than 06:00 UTC.
